query:
SELECT 
                    c.id,
                    c.subject,
                    c.issuer,
                    c.expiration,
                    c.created_at,
                    ARRAY_AGG(s.value) FILTER (WHERE s.value IS NOT NULL) as san_entries
                FROM certificates c
                LEFT JOIN san_entries s ON s.certificate_id = c.id
                WHERE c.id = $1
                GROUP BY c.id
